tradition.name: Portland hip hop
tradition.lineage: Portland hip hop includes the politically engaged MC and DJ practice documented by Mic Crenshaw. His Earthbound project credits guest vocals and DJ Klavical scratches. Recording defaults are an authored contemporary studio realization, not period session reconstruction.

extras.description: Rhythmic lead verses, guest vocal responses, DJ scratches and a produced backing track form this recording model. A sampler is an authored realization of the credited production role; its exact make and sampled content are not claimed. The city scene also includes live bands, and this entry selects the Earthbound MC/DJ branch. Recording chain and room are present-day authored choices, not a reconstruction of the exemplar’s original session.
